findings.summary: Build 2915 failed because the intake caller staged the draft overlay without the expected_draft_version and request_digest the claimed callee reads. The overlay decision now takes items and the authoritative draft version from one _canonical_view read, and stages expected_draft_version plus request_digest from ResumeDraftService.command_digest of the same normalized command the in-memory/direct paths commit. CALLEE_COMMAND_KEYS[resume_draft] carries the two fields; malformed versions fail closed; digest computation stays inside the draft-error mapping. Negative control reproduced the missing-path failure pre-repair. PASS at f07f359fd9e0141b42d61afdc2b49c410ba0417e.

The draft callee no longer owns a transaction unconditionally. It declares an ownership flag, begins a transaction only when @@TRANCOUNT = 0 (direct autocommit driver), commits only its own transaction on every returning path, and rolls back only when it owns one; nested under the intake transaction it participates and commits or rolls back nothing, preserving outer-intake atomicity. Replay-before-version-fence ordering and the semantic receipt digest are unchanged. The previous test assertion was replaced by strictly stronger positive contract checks. PASS at f07f359fd9e0141b42d61afdc2b49c410ba0417e.
